# monotaur_notification_escalation_step (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur notification escalation step by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_notification_escalation_step" "team_lead" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the escalation step to look up.

### Read-Only

- `channel_ids` (List of String) IDs of the notification channels the step notifies.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the step was created.
- `delay_minutes` (Number) Minutes after the alarm was reported that the step fires.
- `notification_policy_id` (String) The ID of the notification policy the step belongs to.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the step was last updated.
